titleLight.text: Landing page + separate planner — light theme

titleDark.text: Landing page + separate planner — dark theme

howto.text:
How to use this prototype

• Press Play on any artboard: the switch, trip type, cabin, aircraft, + Add stop, ? popovers, Share, theme switch and the calculation view all work.
• "See the impact" on a landing page opens the matching planner; the logo leads back. On the planner, "Edit trip" opens the full form.
• Tweaks on Main: page, theme, shared-old-link notice, unknown-airport error state, calculation view open.

Mock data: Prague ⇄ New York JFK. Per-class figures from Google TIM (one way: economy 417.5, premium 579.6, business 1,434.2, first 1,763.9 kg). The stop factor and per-aircraft values are marked as examples.

decide.text:
Decision D6 (2026-11-14): landing page + separate planner.

The user is not overwhelmed at the start; the landing stays fast and map-free; the planner page is the share target.
